name: mudelitehas
description: 3D point placement checked in at least three independent directions before meshing, with a reviewed 5000-quad sedan recipe.

interface.longDescription: Mudelitehas 0.1.2 checks every new model point in at least three views spanning three independent viewing directions before meshing. Save the genuine pre-mesh point cloud, image coordinates, projection residuals and unresolved points. A reviewed 5000-total-quad sedan recipe demonstrates the method. Silhouette support does not prove the true depth or feature triangulation; hidden surfaces remain estimated. Historical 10000-body-quad animated teddy reproduction remains for regression only and does not meet the new three-direction rule. New subjects need an object-specific recipe and suitable registered references. Runs in execution-capable Work/Codex environments with Blender 4.5.3, Python and dependency downloads; Linux x64 setup is tested. This skills-only beta is not a hosted Blender service. Local feedback bundles are sent only when the user chooses. Canonical car and teddy examples are preserved, not silently regenerated by updating instructions.
defaultPrompt: Build the reviewed 5000-quad sedan with three-direction point placement checks.
Check every point in my model cloud in at least three independent viewing directions.
Prepare a local feedback bundle for my Mudelitehas model.

publication.release_notes: 0.1.2: every new model requires per-point placement checks in three independent directions. Includes a reusable witness validator and reviewed 5000-total-quad sedan recipe; historical teddy remains regression-only.

et-EE.subtitle: Kolme suuna punktipaigutus
et-EE.description: Versioon 0.1.2: iga uue mudeli punktipilve punkti tuleb kontrollida vähemalt kolmes vaates ja kolmes sõltumatus suunas enne võrgu loomist. Kaasas 5000 nelinurgaga auto retsept, punktide projektsioonid, kõrvalekalded ja aus vastuolude aruanne. Siluettide sobivus ei tõesta tegelikku sügavust. Vana karu säilib ajaloolise korduskatsena, mitte uue meetodi näidisena. Vajab Blenderi ja Pythoni käivitamist võimaldavat keskkonda.
